name: Shining Angel
source_text: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, you can select 1 LIGHT monster with an ATK of 1500 or less from your Deck and Special Summon it to the field in face-up Attack Position (no Tribute is required for monsters of Level 5 or more). The Deck is then shuffled.
notes: Recruits a LIGHT monster with ATK <= 1500 in face-up Attack Position.
